name: get_weather
description: Get the current weather for a specified city. Example: 'weather in Beijing' -> city='Beijing', unit='celsius'. Unless the user explicitly says 'Fahrenheit', unit is always 'celsius'.

city.description: City name, e.g. 'Beijing', 'Shanghai'. Extract only the city name.

unit.description: Temperature unit. Default is celsius. Only set to 'fahrenheit' if explicitly requested.
